name: Month Year Range
description: Form widgets for month/year (or year-only) entry on core datetime and daterange fields.
project_description:
Month Year Range 

 Provides form widgets for month/year date selection. Users only need to select month and year (or just year), making data entry more efficient for date-based content.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Month Year Range Widget : For date range fields 
 Month Year Datetime Widget : For single datetime fields 
 Flexible ordering : Year/Month, Month/Year, or Year only 
 Optional year ranges : Restrict available years 
 Smart day handling : Auto-set first or last day of month 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as any other Drupal module.

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Enable the Month Year Range module 
 Create a Date or Date Range field 
 In Form Display Settings, select the appropriate widget:
 
 Month Year Range for date range fields 
 Month Year datetime for single date fields 
 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 Date order : Year/Month, Month/Year, or Year only 
 Year range : Optional limits (e.g., 2020:2030 , -5:+5 ) 
 Day options : First or last day of month 
 Back to top
